SAFEAI is a student club at the University of Arizona. We meet to learn about AI safety, discuss the questions it raises, and explore opportunities to work on it.

Students from all majors are welcome. You don’t need a technical background or previous experience with AI safety.

What we do

Our meetings cover both the technical and social questions around AI. Topics include:

  • Alignment: how to get AI systems to behave as intended.
  • Interpretability and evaluations: how to understand what a model is doing and test its behavior.
  • Ethics and governance: how AI should be developed, used, and overseen.

We also explore AI safety research, policy, and career opportunities. Meetings are a place to ask questions and compare ideas with other students.
